title: Bechet's wedding in Antibes
summary: She describes Bechet's wedding as a big, very French and Mediterranean affair, with the Luter orchestra playing.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Yeah. But, again, I keep changing the subject, excuse me. But when Bechet was alive, did you ever see a jazz brass band in Paris or in Europe? No. Not even for his wedding?
Oh, I see the wedding of Bechet in Antibes. It was a big part, but a very French one, I think.

Uh, yes. Well, there was the Luther Orchestra who played, but I have the impression that it was, you know, more French than American. Well, I haven't seen the paradis, I can't compare. But, after what I've been able to read, I don't think that it was the same thing. It was a very, very French, and especially very Mediterranean, because it happened in Antibes.
